Document type: adjuster_file. Page 1 of 2.

<page>
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1350
Claimant:
Sarah Perez
Adjuster:
Christopher Wong
8-7-24
The claimant reported a rear-end collision at a signalled intersection and a knee injury. The claimant is not
represented by an attorney, so all communication is directly with the claimant.
8-10-24
Police attended and filed a report. The responding officer and two independent witnesses stated that the claimant
was not inside the vehicle at the time of impact, which conflicts with the initial account and needs follow-up.
10-1-24
Photos from the scene and the ohter driver's statement both match the descriptoin of how the collision occurred. The
other driver's insurer has been notified.
11-23-24
The calimant was asked to clarify their position at impact. In a follow-up call the claimant added a few minor details,
such as the approximate speed and the lane positions, but the core account of events did not change.
12-14-24
The driver named on the policy confirmed the coverage was active at the time of loss. Nothing in the file suggests the
vehicle damage predates the policy start.
1-5-25
No prior damage to the vehicle has been identified in the records or inspection. The repair estimate is under review,
and it is not yet clear whether all listed damage came from this impact.
1-14-25
The claimant reoprted the knee injury after the collision and was seen at urgent care. The injury pattern appears
consistent with the force and direction of the impact.
2-2-25
Medical records show a standard course of physiotherapy, and the claimant's reported pain has steadily decreased
with treatment. No earlier injury to the same knee is known from the claimant's history or prior claims search.
2-19-25
Treatment is tapering off and the claimant reports improving mobility. The file will be reviewed again once the final
treatment notes are received.
3-2-25
The claim remains open pending the repair estimate review and the resolution of the discrepancy about the claimant's
position in the vehicle at impact.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page
says nothing about. The ratings are listed from least to most suspicious.
- injury_crash_fit: Does the claimed injury fit the type and force of the crash? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- treatment_growth: Did the treatment grow beyond what this injury needs? Allowed: Normal, Elevated, Disproportionate, Extreme.
- pre_existing_condition: Did an earlier condition of the same body area add to the complaints? Allowed: None, Minor, Material, Predominant.
- occurrence_support: Do independent sources (witnesses, photos, cameras, the other driver) confirm that the accident happened as described? Allowed: Confirmed, Partially corroborated, Uncorroborated, Contradicted, Suspected staged.
- damage_crash_fit: Does the vehicle damage fit the described impact? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- account_stability: Did the claimant's account of the accident stay the same over time? Allowed: Stable, Clarified, Materially changed.
- occupant_presence: Was the claimant really in the vehicle at the time of the crash? Allowed: Verified, Unclear, Added later, Not present.
- prior_damage_evidence: Is there evidence of vehicle damage from before this crash? Allowed: None, Possible, Documented, Material.
- known_loss_evidence: Is there evidence the damage existed or was known before the coverage started? Allowed: Weak, Moderate, Strong.
- driver_status: Is the driver of the insured vehicle on the policy? Allowed: Listed, Household, Unlisted, Excluded.

For each rated feature give:
- "rating": exactly one of the allowed ratings,
- "confidence": "High", "Medium" or "Low" (how clearly the page shows it),
- "quote": one or two sentences copied EXACTLY from the page that support the rating, with any
  spelling errors as they are,
- "reason": one short sentence.
